decision.observation: The farmer is back at the farmhouse door on the central porch at 2:40 p.m.; the stairs lead directly downward.
decision.hypothesis: Descending the central stairs, then moving east below the farmhouse wall, should reach the clear route past the mailbox without hitting the porch's blocked right edge.
decision.memory: Willy promised an item at the southeast beach. The porch's right edge is blocked; use the central stairs. Travel east through the bus stop into Pelican Town, then seek a southern route instead of continuing to the eastern riverbank.
